say:1:1320707001:1.text: Do you have any candied crystalberries?
say:1:1320707001:1.source_cn: 有没有冰晶莓做的果脯？

say:2:1320707002:1.text: Oh, you're in luck! My family grows them. They're way bigger and sweeter than the wild ones.
say:2:1320707002:1.source_cn: 你找对人了！我家都是自己种的冰晶莓，比野外采摘的那些个...

say:3:1320707003:0.text: We even dry them over premium coal for a chewy texture with a hint of smokiness.
say:3:1320707003:0.source_cn: 我家烘干果脯用的上好煤炭，烘出来的果肉不仅口感弹软，还...

say:8:1320707008:0.text: You're not a local, are you? Around here, we say you get what you pay for.
say:8:1320707008:0.source_cn: 小哥，我看你这模样不是本地人，你知道一分钱一分货的道理吗？

say:9:1320707009:0.text: Yeah, but my wallet says I need to save for other things, too...
say:9:1320707009:0.source_cn: 知道是知道……可我还想留些钱买点别的。

choice_prompt:10:1320707009.text: Yeah, but my wallet says I need to save for other things, too...
choice_prompt:10:1320707009.source_cn: 知道是知道……可我还想留些钱买点别的。

say:11:1320707010:1.text: Feel free to shop around, but you'll see mine are the best.
say:11:1320707010:1.source_cn: 你们先去别家尝尝看嘛，尝了就知道还是我家的最好吃。

say:12:1320707012:1.text: Take your time. I've got deliveries to make anyway.
say:12:1320707012:1.source_cn: 反正我是不讲价的，你们先慢慢琢磨着吧，我要去镇外送货。

say:13:1320707013:1.text: Deliveries? Well, I know this saying: "Not even the wind whispers without purpose."
say:13:1320707013:1.source_cn: 送货？老板娘，我知道雪松镇有一句俚语：唯有死亡免费。

say:14:1320707014:1.text: How about this; I help with your deliveries, and you knock some off the price?
say:14:1320707014:1.source_cn: 你看这样行不行，我去帮你送货，你能不能便宜点卖给我？

say:15:1320707015:1.text: Hmm... maybe. But first, sort out that box over there. Some candied fruit got mixed into it earlier.
say:15:1320707015:1.source_cn: 还挺热心呀，那你先把那一箱乱七八糟的东西收拾好，刚才有...

say:16:1320707016:0.text: You're so kind and beautiful, surely you wouldn't make me work for free?
say:16:1320707016:0.source_cn: 老板娘，你美丽又温柔，肯定不会让我白干活吧？

say:17:1320707017:0.text: Flattery's cute, but it doesn't work on me. If you want a deal, you've gotta earn it.
say:17:1320707017:0.source_cn: 年轻人，嘴真甜呢，但我可没这么容易上当，你想从我这里捞...

say:18:1320707018:1.text: Ahh, fine! For the sake of my poor wallet, I'll do the best sorting job ever!
say:18:1320707018:1.source_cn: 好吧，为了省钱，我会努力展现出诚意的！

choice_prompt:19:1320707018.text: Ahh, fine! For the sake of my poor wallet, I'll do the best sorting job ever!
choice_prompt:19:1320707018.source_cn: 好吧，为了省钱，我会努力展现出诚意的！

say:20:1320707019:0.text: Mister, could you lend a hand too? To be frank, this big box might be difficult for a single person to sort through.

say:20:1320707019:0.female: Miss, could you lend a hand too? To be frank, this big box might be difficult for a single person to sort through.

choice_prompt:21:1320707019.female: Miss, could you lend a hand too? To be frank, this big box might be difficult for a single person to sort through.

say:22:1320707020:0.source_cn: 你帮我解决了麻烦，我心情一好，说不定什么都答应了。
say:22:1320707020:0.male: If you help me, I might be in a good enough mood to do you a favor.
say:22:1320707020:0.female: If you help me, I might be in a good enough mood to do you a favor.

say:23:1320707025:1.text: Alright, you two, enough chit-chat. Let's see what you can do!
say:23:1320707025:1.source_cn: 二位，先干活吧。我很期待你们的表现哦。

say:29:1320707024:1.female: Of course! I'll rack my brains and think of something great, for sure!
